verdict.rationale: ClickHouse is a column-oriented DBMS built for real-time analytics. Its docs claim millisecond queries at petabyte scale and describe materialized views that move aggregation cost to insert time for faster SELECTs. Independent users report real-time aggregation over hundreds of millions of daily rows, results orders of magnitude faster than Postgres, and production use powering in-product analytics and BI tools. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of aggregation query performance and dashboard-latency benchmarks, and evidence addressing the community-reported JOIN limitations for complex aggregations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run heavy analytical aggregations over large tables fast enough for dashboards without exporting to a separate warehouse
